shortlist.proposal: Batch workspace credential/plugin ID reads at the repository/service boundary; remove adapter ORM lookups.
shortlist.impact: Dashboard list and detail reads; per-workspace repeated queries and discarded prefetches.
shortlist.risk: Low/medium: preserve ID order, provider-secret filtering, and authorization; do not change image version behavior.

shortlist.proposal: Index step markers/errors once per projection rather than scanning all parts for each plan.
shortlist.impact: Repeated on streaming computer-use turns; 500-step projection exceeds a 16-ms frame budget.
shortlist.risk: Low/medium: preserve legacy status, errors, missing/duplicate markers; needs running UI verification.

shortlist.proposal: Bound concurrent read-only untracked-file diff work while retaining ordered results and operation lock.
shortlist.impact: Diff panel on new projects: 50 untracked paths cause 55 sequential runtime calls.
shortlist.risk: Medium: SSH channel limits, cancellation, aggregate memory/output bounds, and failure ordering.
